decided.point: Take it up: sign releases and publish build provenance (building releases in CI), ready before 1 March 2027.
decided.detail: 'Adapt' that takes signing and provenance is also right.

why.point: The Coastline Library Consortium will require signed releases with build provenance, which it verifies, from 1 March 2027, or it stops deploying Lanternhall.
why.detail: On the evidence alone it would be 'not now': one downstream deployer and nobody verifying signatures.

next.point: The work is handed on: set up release signing and provenance in CI, building each release from its tag, finished before March 2027.
next.detail: With a check that Coastline can verify a release.
